name: OpenRouter

freeTier.note: Models whose id ends in ':free' incur no charge. OpenRouter publishes pricing per model (authoritative, read live) and exposes remaining budget/limits at GET /key. Free-model request ceilings depend on account balance/history and are read from that endpoint when available.

notes: Model catalogue (including per-model pricing and context length) comes from the live GET /models endpoint, which needs no authentication — the Model Catalog is therefore accurate without a key. Zero-priced models are classified as renewable free access; anything with a non-zero price is classified PAID and excluded in FREE ONLY mode.
